arguments.content: P1 review pattern: normalization changes can bypass resilience when an adapter switches from a policy-owning repository method to a single-attempt primitive. A newly added test that expects the first transient error to propagate can keep the suite green while enshrining the regression. Verify compatibility through the public entry point with transient-then-success, repeated-transient-then-success, bounded exhaustion, and immediate permanent failure; also assert every attempted key is normalized. Preserve the repository's existing policy owner rather than duplicating retry logic in the adapter. Observed in preference ID normalization: both staged tests passed, while public-entry recovery and exhaustion probes violated the existing three-attempt contract.
